entities.summary: Todor Batkov (b. 1958-10-17, Zagrazhden) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zagrazhden and Bulgaria. Known in the fields of bulgaria, merchants & economists, europe.
